_comment: Documentation template only. The installer generates ~/.gemini/config/mcp_config.json dynamically from your resolved Antigravity paths, merging into any existing config. Replace <ANTIGRAVITY_RESOURCES> with %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\antigravity\resources and use the dynamic entrypoint (out\Default\gen\src\bin\chrome-devtools-mcp.js for v1.13+ or build\src\bin\chrome-devtools-mcp.js for earlier versions).
